messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: runtime latency anomaly detected in canary pool (prod-us-west-2). 90th pct latency increased ~3x after release 2026-03-17T21:00Z. Paging team and oncall.
Ashley: saw the alert, jumping in. canary traffic is ~5% already. tagging @oncall for handoff.
oncall: I'm on it. pulling canary logs now.
Lia: looking at kernel selection logs — I see a pattern: fallback to generic kernel on ~40% of requests, then batch size drops to 1. cause looks deploy-related (quant route changes).
Devon: if kernel fallback is happening we should consider kill-flag for the feature gate. can we flip ff/runtime-adaptive-quant -> off for canary?
Sanjay: confirmed: rollout pushed new quant routing in the same release. kernel mismatch on long-context (>1024) requests. batching window also reduced by controller because latency spiked.
Ashley: Maria, any customer P1s hitting errors yet?
Maria: CS reporting elevated latencies for a handful of enterprise customers in us-west. No error traces yet, mostly slow generation (timeout close calls). notifying them with a heads-up.
oncall: I'm preparing a quick mitigation: 1) flip runtime-adaptive-quant ff -> off 2) rollback canary traffic to previous canary model variant 3) enable warm-KV affinity to reduce fallback.
Lia: commands tested in staging, flip command: ```
# flip feature flag for canary group
redwoodctl ff set runtime-adaptive-quant off --env prod --group canary
```
Devon: doing kill-flag now for canary.
Devon: `redwoodctl ff set runtime-adaptive-quant off --env prod --group canary` -> OK. observing collector.
Sanjay: pushing a lightweight rollback of model-route for canary to previous variant: ``redwoodctl route update canary --model model-v2.3 --to model-v2.2``
Ashley: traffic shifted back to model-v2.2 for canary, observing metrics.
oncall: metric check: 90p latency dropping back towards baseline over last 30s. batch sizes recovering.
Maria: CS update sent: short note about temporary slowdown and we're rolling a mitigation; advise customers to retry. no escalations.
Lia: kernel logs show fallback counts down 80% -> 5% since flag flip.
Devon: keeping the flag off until we confirm stability across regions. scheduling postmortem and root-cause triage.
Ashley: handoff to normal oncall for monitoring: @oncall will watch the rollout for 2 hours, then we reconvene for RCA plan.
oncall: acknowledged. creating incident ticket INC-2026-0317-42 and assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml for RCA. :white_check_mark:
Maria: adding customer impact notes to the ticket and linking the CS thread.
Sanjay: next steps: reproduce with longer context, add a guard in kernel selector, and add an automatic rollback rule if kernel-fallback rate > 10% in 1m.
Ashley: thanks everyone. I'll schedule the postmortem and include timeline + commands we ran.
